name: All Time Kalshi Exotics Volume
query_sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        CAST("Volume" AS DOUBLE) AS volume
    FROM query_5910819
)
SELECT
    SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Exotics') AS total_exotics_vol,
    SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Sports')  AS total_sports_vol,
    SUM(volume)                                     AS total_kalshi_vol,
    100.0 * SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Exotics') / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0) AS total_exotics_pct
FROM src
